doc.md:
Draws a horizontal or vertical line to separate other widgets.

A `GtkSeparator` can be used to group the widgets within a window.
It displays a line with a shadow to make it appear sunken into the
interface.

# CSS nodes

`GtkSeparator` has a single CSS node with name separator. The node
gets one of the .horizontal or .vertical style classes.

# Accessibility

`GtkSeparator` uses the [`AccessibleRole.separator`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:separator) role.
